node.text: It will be dry tonight with high clouds. The next system will begin to impact Ohio tomorrow. We have an alert for rain and thunder tomorrow. The rain moves in after 8:00 a.m. It looks like it will come in waves through the day and night. It will be a windy day with the winds generally out of the east. The alert continues on Friday with more rain likely.
FIRST WEEKEND OF APRIL: Cooler but mainly dry.

Planning your weekend?
I've got everything you need to know about the forecast in the attached video.
